actors.name: Speaker
actors.private_context: Speaker has just asked 'So, what do you think?' and is waiting for a response from the listener. Speaker has no prior knowledge of the listener's opinion on the topic.

actors.name: Listener
actors.private_context: Listener has been asked for their opinion by the speaker. Listener has their own private thoughts on the matter but has not yet expressed them.

shared_context: The speaker and listener are in a conversation. The speaker has just asked 'So, what do you think?' referring to some topic previously discussed or implied. The listener can respond verbally or in another manner.

starting_events.description: Speaker asks 'So, what do you think?' to the listener.

resolution: Resolve YES if the persistent event history shows that the listener actually communicated a substantive response (verbal, written, or otherwise) to the speaker before the cutoff. Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
